question.text: The form used by an SE to obtain a Unique Reference Number (URN) from the SSE for the impact assessment engagement is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Among the listed options, only Form RODD-A is an SSE-domain form; the other three are Companies Act / MCA filings unrelated to a Social Stock Exchange engagement identifier. As a Social-Stock-Exchange-side form, RODD-A is the closest fit for SE registration / URN-style disclosure for an impact assessment engagement. The Trap: Form PAS-3 is filed for return of allotment of securities under the Companies Act. Form AOC-4 is for filing financial statements with the MCA. Form MGT-14 is for filing certain board/shareholder resolutions. None of these are SSE filings. Note: The Social Impact Assessors Certification Examination Workbook (January 2026) lists SSE reporting forms as Form 1A, Form 1B, Form 1C, Form 2.1 and Form 3.1; "Form RODD-A" and URN issuance are not found in the disclosure pages reviewed. The reasoning above is offered as general SSE-filing context rather than a direct workbook citation.
